# Sovren Software

> Customer-owned infrastructure for reliable agentic work: verified workflows, local identity, and programmable capital.

Sovren Software builds tools for people and companies that need agents to act reliably without giving vendors control of the workflow, identity, or assets underneath. The core product is Esver OS: a governed workspace and runtime that turns repeated company workflows into verified executable skills agents can run on local or customer-controlled infrastructure.

Website: https://sovren.software
GitHub: https://github.com/sovren-software
Contact: hello@sovren.software

---

## Products

### Esver OS

**Category:** Governed AI workspace / Customer-owned agent runtime
**Status:** Private development
**URL:** https://sovren.software/esver
**Product site:** https://esver.computer
**GitHub:** https://github.com/sovren-software

Esver OS turns repeated company workflows into verified executable skills that agents can run reliably under customer-owned control. It is not a generic chatbot, not a docs-search layer, and not a cloud bot farm. It is an operating layer for making company work executable.

Plain-language positioning: teach Esver how a job is done once, verify the steps, then let agents rerun it safely.

Product ladder:
- **Task:** One thing someone needs done.
- **Workflow:** The repeated path through tools, context, decisions, and checks.
- **Skill:** A verified workflow an agent can execute with evidence gates.
- **Role:** A set of skills that serves a person, team, or business function.

Key capabilities:
- **Workflow capture:** Preserve the tools, context, decisions, and evidence that make repeated work succeed.
- **Skill verification:** Convert workflows into skills only when they have boundaries, answer gates, evidence checks, and repeatable execution paths.
- **Customer-owned runtime:** Run skills on local or customer-controlled infrastructure rather than routing sensitive work through a vendor black box.
- **Authority boundaries:** Human approval, audit trails, local memory, and rollback are part of the operating layer.
- **Persistent workflow intelligence:** The durable asset is not a prompt. It is the verified workflow: what context was needed, which route worked, which answer was acceptable, what evidence was captured, and where human authority was required.

Built on: NixOS / Linux. Runtime: local or customer-controlled. Unit of value: verified executable skills. Trust model: customer-owned control, evidence gates, human-approved authority.

---

### Visage

**Category:** Identity / Authentication
**Status:** Live — v0.2.0
**URL:** https://sovren.software/visage
**GitHub:** https://github.com/sovren-software/visage
**License:** MIT (open source)

Visage is a Linux face authentication daemon that works as a PAM module. Windows Hello has worked on Windows for years — Visage closes that gap for Linux. ONNX inference runs entirely on-device: no cloud enrollment, no biometric database, no data leaving your hardware.

Key capabilities:
- **Local ONNX inference:** Face recognition model runs on your hardware. Your biometrics never leave your machine.
- **PAM integration:** Drop-in replacement for any PAM-based authentication stack. Works with sudo, screen lock, and login without modifying existing system configuration.
- **IR camera support:** Native support for Windows Hello-compatible IR cameras. Liveness detection built in.
- **Sub-second authentication:** Persistent daemon keeps the model resident for fast authentication.

Built in Rust. Auth: PAM module. Camera: RGB + IR via V4L2. Inference: ONNX, on-device. Ships standalone; integrates natively with Esver OS.

---

### Mr. Haven

**Category:** Finance / Asset Management
**Status:** Live on Base L2 (Mainnet)
**URL:** https://sovren.software/mrhaven
**Product site:** https://mrhaven.io
**GitHub:** https://github.com/sovren-software/mr-haven

Mr. Haven is a non-custodial USDC time vault protocol deployed on Base L2. Deposit USDC, define conditions, name beneficiaries or autonomous agents, and the smart contract handles execution with no intermediary.

Key capabilities:
- **Time vault:** Lock USDC for any duration. Set exact unlock timestamps or recurring release schedules.
- **Inactivity trigger:** Set a threshold: if you go offline for X days, funds transfer.
- **Beneficiary designations:** Designate multiple beneficiaries with percentage splits.
- **Non-custodial:** Your keys, your rules. No admin key. No company can freeze, redirect, or reclaim funds.

Chain: Base L2. Asset: USDC. Standard: ERC4626 vault. Custody: non-custodial. Smart contract only.

---

## The Thesis

Modern AI products often ask companies to trust an external service with the context, memory, and authority required to perform work. Sovren Software moves that control back to the customer.

The company thesis is simple: repeated work should become verified infrastructure. When a workflow is captured, checked, and made executable, agents can stop rediscovering the job every time. They can run the work inside boundaries the owner controls.

> Verified work. Local identity. Programmable capital. Customer-owned control.
